activation_entry_cases.expected_behavior: With no recognized Carrier, return unmanaged and do not invent or post a lifecycle. Recognized invalid, terminal, or incomplete history still fails closed.
Start the ordinary GTP lifecycle without asking for a mode and reconstruct state from Records and GitHub facts.
Do not activate a PR-specific lifecycle, infer a Contract, or create a Carrier merely because of the entry surface.
If the related Issue is identified, reconstruct the same existing lifecycle; do not create a separate entry-specific protocol.

limits: This is a public-spec reconstruction, not an implementation execution.
Anonymous rate limiting prevented an independent complete enumeration of PR reviews and comments.
The probe does not establish actor identity, authority, Evidence truth, natural-language fulfillment, or deployment facts.
A zero match count applies only to the named final targets at the scan time.
The scan cannot prove that every private-data form is absent or that a credential is valid or owned.
Public reconstruction shows what the published Records support; it does not prove omitted private facts do not exist.
